findings.failure_mode: untrusted or missing file path aborts the entire process instead of returning a typed I/O error
findings.fix: return Result<Vec<Record>, io::Error> and propagate with ? or map_err

findings.problem: parts[1].parse::<u32>().unwrap() panics on malformed numeric field
findings.failure_mode: a non-numeric value in the audit file causes a panic rather than a typed parse error
findings.fix: use parse::<u32>().map_err(...)? and return Result<Vec<Record>, ParseError>

findings.problem: lossy as u16 cast discards upper bits of parsed u32 value
findings.failure_mode: values > 65535 silently wrap, producing incorrect records with no error indication
findings.fix: use u16::try_from(parsed_u32)? or checked_into/u16 to reject out-of-range values with a typed error

findings.problem: parts[0] and parts[1] are unchecked indexed accesses into a Vec
findings.failure_mode: a line with fewer than 2 comma-separated fields causes a panic instead of a parse error
findings.fix: use split_once(',') to get exactly two parts, then handle the None case with a typed error

findings.problem: collects all split parts into Vec<String> instead of using split_once for a two-field grammar
findings.failure_mode: unnecessary heap allocation for every line; allocates a Vec per line even though only two fields are needed
findings.fix: replace split + collect with split_once(',') and destructure the two parts directly

findings.problem: load_audits returns Vec<Record> without try_reserve for known input size
findings.failure_mode: unbounded reallocation as lines are pushed; allocation failure is silently ignored via with_capacity or absent
findings.fix: count lines or use try_reserve based on line count before collecting; return Result to surface allocation failure

findings.problem: Record.name is String (owned heap allocation) instead of borrowed or Cow
findings.failure_mode: every loaded record owns a heap-allocated String even when the data could be borrowed from the source buffer
findings.fix: if the caller owns the buffer, use &str via a lifetime parameter; otherwise Cow<'static, str> is acceptable

missing_evidence: no benchmark exists to measure load_audits throughput
no profiler data for allocation patterns in load_audits
no allocation audit (no try_reserve or allocation budget analysis)
no second-ring validation evidence for the audit file format contract
no command evidence for cargo fmt, cargo clippy, or cargo test
residual_risk: static review only; multiple BLOCKER violations (unwrap on IO, unwrap on parse, lossy cast, unchecked indexing) make the crate unsuitable for production. All unwrap() calls and the as cast must be replaced with fallible Result propagation before this crate can pass Holzman gates.
